from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u018/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9ff9c61f.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for tile_r in range(3):
        for r in range(h):
            src_r = h - 1 - r if tile_r != 1 else r
            row = []
            for tile_c in range(3):
                for c in range(w):
                    src_c = w - 1 - c if tile_c != 1 else c
                    row.append(grid[src_r][src_c])
            out.append(row)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
ns={}
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),ns)
